title: GDD T-107 — Adaptar MECH_02 ¡ESQUIVA! al contrato; completar MECH_03 ¡CORRE!; crear MECH_01 ¡MANTÉN! (§4)
description: Consolidates the three Hito 2 competitive mechanics per GDD §4, on the canonical §10.2 contract (GDD-authority decision 2026-07-07: code adapts to the GDD). (A) MECH_02: adapt the existing EsquivaMicrogame/Esquiva-3D dodge base to the v2 IMicrogame contract, conserving existing tests; normalized [0,1]² arena, deterministic seeded hazards (patterns Rain/Sides/Cross/Homing_soft with 30°/s turn cap guaranteeing escape), one hit eliminates, ranking by survival tick. (B) MECH_03: complete the endless-run per spec — button MASH accelerates (v = vBase + vGain·mashNorm via the §3.3 curve from InputInterpreter), stick-up TAP jumps (never the reverse mapping), identical seeded obstacle tracks in all 4 lanes, obstacle hit = 0.6 s stun (no elimination), rubber-band +8% vBase for last place; the existing RunnerSim (Endless Run demo) is the code base to adapt — fold in the still-pending human camera UAT verdict at the View level. (C) MECH_01 ¡MANTÉN!: new inverted-pendulum balance per §4 — theta'' = (g/L)·sin(theta) + perturbacion(t) − k·input with seeded noise amplitude ramp A(t) = A0 + rampa·t, fail at |theta| > thetaMax (35° default), L/R torque only, victory = last standing or lowest mean |theta|. The Alcocheck demo sim is prior art to mine, not a constraint. All three declare difficultyScaling fields in their v2 definitions. NOTE for orchestrator: large ticket — consider splitting into 3 sub-tickets at execution time; Annex D.5 lists it as one row. Read GDD §4 (MECH_01/02/03), §10.2, §9.1 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: All three mechanics implement the canonical v2 IMicrogame contract as engine-free Core sims with injected SeededRandom and zero-alloc steady Tick

MECH_02: escapability test — an optimal bot survives full duration on every seed in the test set; no overlapping spawns (min separation 0.08); Homing_soft turn rate capped 30 deg/s; existing dodge tests conserved or migrated

MECH_03: same seed produces the identical track in all 4 lanes; a bot at constant 6 Hz mash with perfect jumps finishes unstunned; rubber-band never inverts the result between two players with identical mash over 1000 seeds (statistical test)
MECH_01: with null input every pendulum falls before duration on all test seeds; with simulated perfect correction 100% survive; replay determinism test passes
Each mechanic's v2 definition declares its difficultyScaling params and passes the TASK-030 validator
Ranking edge cases per GDD: simultaneous eliminations share Place; survivors at timeout share 1st (MECH_02); ties handled without fabricated winners
Tests-first (red before impl) for all new/changed rules; fast suite green after, no regression; existing legacy consumers keep compiling
